newsitem.title: ESTONIA: CITY TO SELL TALLINNA STAKE OUTSIDE BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: CITY TO SELL TALLINNA STAKE OUTSIDE BOURSE.

text.p: Tallinn's city government said on Thursday that it plans to sell its seven percent stake in Tallinna Pank outside the stock exchange.
"According to the project, the council will allow the city government to sell the shares outside the bourse," spokesperson Jaano Martin Ots told Reuters.
"The price of the shares must not be lower than their price on the Tallinn stock exchange on the day they are sold," he added.
"The sales price must be paid when signing the agreement and in money," Ots said.
The Tallinn city government said earlier it will decide on Friday to propose to the city council to sell 615,240 shares in Tallinna Pank.
The city government has to approve the decision, which goes to council then, Ots said.
"Council will discuss it as soon as possible," he added.
"The city's principle is that it is not an entrepreneur...and Tallinna Pank is not a company the city should have stake in, in order to execute its functions," Ots added.
